metadata.description: Founder-only TFDD survival prediction from GitHub commit histories. our_method uses pre-departure authority-diffusion trajectory (founder_share, n_diffused_owners in the 12-6mo pre-TFDD window); baseline uses only snapshot size/popularity covariates at TFDD (Avelino et al. style).

examples.input: Repo OtusGolang/webinars_practical_part (Go): founder-only TFDD detected at 2022-10-09T20:53:55+03:00. Predict whether the project survives (attracts a non-founder truck-factor owner) over the following 18 months, given pre-departure trajectory founder_share=0.077, n_diffused_owners=6, and snapshot covariates stars=103, forks=64, devs_at_tfdd=10, commits_at_tfdd=119, files_at_tfdd=881.
